items.title: Earnings live updates: Klarna stock plunges on trimmed guidance, Home Depot gains
items.summary: Retail earnings are set to offer a check of consumer health this week as the second quarter earnings season winds down.

items.title: Target and Home Depot take center stage as investors size up consumers
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Opening Bid panel focuses on the Sector of the Day: Retail, as Home Depot (HD) and Target (TGT) report earnings this week. Meanwhile, the 30-year Treasury yield climbs to levels not seen since 2007, giving investors another key read on the strength of the consumer.

items.title: Target’s Stock Down 40% In Five Years
items.summary: While Walmart and Costco have rewarded investors handsomely over the past five years, Target has done the opposite, and a new CEO now carries the weight of proving the struggling retailer can truly turn the corner.

items.title: Target's Pre-Q2 Earnings: Is TGT Ready to Surprise the Street Again?
items.summary: Target heads into Q2 earnings with rising estimates, an earnings-beat setup and stronger merchandising, though costs and tough comparisons remain key risks.

items.title: Target Is Up 56% and Reports Earnings Aug. 19. This Is the Only Reason I'd Need to Buy.
items.summary: Investors need to see continued growth to believe in the stock's recovery.

items.title: Target or Lowe’s: Which Stock Is Poised to Soar After Earnings?
items.summary: Target and Lowe's both report earnings on the same morning, putting two very different bets on the American consumer head to head. Which one actually deserves your retirement capital before the opening bell?

items.title: A Top Strategist Says This Market Is Flying on One Engine. He Thinks It Could Stall
items.summary: One strategist on CNBC compared today's market to a plane running on a single engine, and he named exactly which names would go down first if that engine cuts out. The consumer stocks in your portfolio may be more exposed than you think.

items.title: Top Retail Analyst: Target Offers More Upside Than Walmart Today Ahead of Earnings This Week
items.summary: Jefferies analyst Corey Tarlowe says Target still holds more upside than Walmart heading into earnings this week, and his reasoning comes down to a metric most investors overlook when a stock has already surged 47%.
